rpc.description: Rpc: Middleware for Effect RPC and the three Transports (http, websocket, inProcess), each a client and server pair with the protocol fixed. Never imports Alchemy, and Cloudflare only as types.
rpc.ts gathers Middleware and the three Transports into the Rpc namespace; each Transport stands alone.

http-api.description: HttpApi: the same Middleware for Effect HttpApi, with security schemes. Shares vocabulary with rpc, not code.

alchemy.description: Alchemy deploy declarations: a Worker and Durable Object serving an Api over Rpc.websocket.server.

rpc-toolkit.description: rpc and http-api stand alone; alchemy deploys rpc's websocket server.
